newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices edge up, bund spread narrows.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices edge up, bund spread narrows.

text.p: Danish bond prices moved up in early trade, supported by encouraging fundamentals and prospects of increased liquidity from the new month's coupon payments.
Dealers expected the 10-year spread to the bund to test 60 basis points soon, as the gap narrowed on Tuesday morning.

At 0800 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was up to 112.42, yielding 6.10 percent, from Thursday's 112.40 and the seven percent 2007, due to become the benchmark on September 1, rose 0.02 point to 105.00, yielding 6.32 percent.
The 2007 gap to the bund closed one basis point to 61 bp.
The crown inched to 3.8067 to the mark from 3.8068.
